recognize_zh: 細胞質塞滿大小一致、圓形粗大的顆粒，顆粒間可見雙葉核的輪廓；均勻的圓形大顆粒加上雙葉核就是嗜酸性球。本張染色偏暗，顆粒呈紫紅褐色而非典型橘紅色。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than a neutrophil
Bilobed nucleus partly obscured by overlying granules
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, round, coarse granules
Granules appear dark red-purple in this image, likely stain-related rather than the classic bright orange
Surrounding red cells with poikilocytes and a crenated cell
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm completely filled with large, uniform, round granules. The granules stain darker red-purple than usual, likely reflecting staining conditions, but their uniform size and spherical shape, with a visible bilobed nucleus beneath, support eosinophilic granules. Adjacent red cells show mild poikilocytosis with an echinocyte. Findings are consistent with a mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are irregular in size, deep purple-black and obscure the nucleus, rather than uniform round refractile granules.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and scattered in pink cytoplasm with a multilobed nucleus clearly visible.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophil of AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Inv(16) eosinophils are immature forms with large dark basophilic granules mixed with orange granules, found alongside increased blasts.
